# Pixel Notes

A pixel-themed notes app with three tabs (Work, Home, Ideas). Each tab retains its own text content when switching, the active tab is highlighted, and a character count is shown per tab.

## Features

- Three independent note tabs: Work, Home, Ideas
- Content is kept in memory when switching tabs
- Active tab is visually highlighted
- Live character count per tab
- Fully keyboard accessible (ARIA tabs pattern: arrow keys, Home/End, Enter/Space)
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel-art inspired styling using only CSS
- No external dependencies, no network requests, works offline

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Type in the text area for each tab. Switch tabs to see that content is preserved. Use arrow keys to navigate tabs when a tab is focused.

## Files

- `index.html` – markup and structure
- `styles.css` – pixel-themed styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` – tab switching, content retention, character counting

## Accessibility

- Tabs use `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, and `aria-controls`
- Panels use `role="tabpanel"` and `aria-labelledby`
- Text areas are labeled and linked to character count via `aria-describedby`
- Character counts are announced via `aria-live="polite"`
- Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements

## Known Limitations

- Notes are stored in memory only; refreshing the page clears content (no localStorage used to keep the app dependency-free and simple).
- Character count includes all characters (spaces, newlines).
